correctness.rationale: TARGET route: headline claims full proof that u_*=u_** in (0,infty) on H_3(Z). Draft is an acknowledged porting sketch, not a proof: it verifies volume/Green/Harnack inputs (BFS to R=14 confirms only (G1)) then asserts the 96-page Z^d finite-range/OSSS/interpolation machinery transfers with d->nu=4 without line-by-line verification. Essential inferences unverified: Ráth-type small-u contour with L^3 surface capacity on Heisenberg, cascading/renormalization finiteness lemma, box-to-ball tiling, obstacle coupling, OSSS revealment/surgery constants, torus-to-nilpotent transfer, and inner/outer boundary comparability. Capacity derivation formula is garbled and no quantitative decay is derived on G. Self-declared residual risk in surgery confirms incompleteness. Experimental volume check does not substitute for the hard-direction proof.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent-notation, and broader-coverage forms returned only Z^d sharpness literature plus general-construction papers. Full-text parameter searches for Heisenberg/nilpotent/Cayley in arXiv:2308.07919 (412k chars), its companion arXiv:2308.07920 (187k chars), and arXiv:2504.02777 (128k chars) yield zero hits; all three state scope as Z^d/(Z/NZ)^d. General transient-graph work (Teixeira 2009) predates the 2023 resolution of the Z^d equality described as long-purported, so cannot contain Heisenberg sharpness. No table, database, census, or classification covering H_3(Z) u_*=u_** was found. Claim is substantively new and not mechanically implied.

value.rationale: If proved, equality u_*=u_** in (0,infty) for random interlacements on the integer Heisenberg Cayley graph would be independently worth retrieving: first sharpness result beyond Z^d for a natural non-abelian nilpotent group of homogeneous dimension 4, advancing the recognized Sznitman u_*/u_** program resolved on Z^d in 2023. Object and invariant were motivated before computation, value is not known or mechanically implied, and future work on nilpotent interlacements could need the fact. Not a textbook restatement, mere parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
